episode.title: Working Late
goal: I can read changing work times and explain a new plan.
変更された仕事の時刻を読み、新しい予定を説明できる。
intro: Emma and Ren work late on a project. The client wants changes. Leo asks when Emma can meet in Kyoto. Emma needs to give him the latest deadline and explain that her finish time is not certain.
エマとレンはプロジェクトで残業しています。顧客が変更を求めています。レオは京都でいつ会えるか尋ねます。エマは最新の締め切りを伝え、終了時刻は確定していないと説明する必要があります。
episode.warmup: What can you say in this situation?
words: 顧客は変更を求めています。
7時30分に終わるかもしれません。
それは確かではありません。
新しい状況を知らせます。
I do not know my arrival time.
到着時刻は分かりません。
discussion: II. Use two of the new expressions to talk about this situation.
この場面について、新しい表現を二つ使って話しましょう。
episode.followup: What question can you ask next?

rule: Use will + verb for a future action.
will ＋動詞で、これからすることを伝えます。
examples: メッセージを送ります。

rule: Use before or after to show the order.
before や after で順番を表します。
examples: I will ask before I decide.

situation: Read the project messages and Leo's message. Find the latest information before replying.
プロジェクトの連絡とレオのメッセージを読みましょう。返事をする前に最新の情報を確認しましょう。
apply.text:
Monday project updates

4:00 p.m. - Team lead: We expect to finish at six today.

5:15 p.m. - Team lead: The client needs a new cover. Send the revised files by seven. We may finish around seven thirty, but that is not confirmed.

5:20 p.m. - Ren: I can check the files while you finish the cover.

5:25 p.m. - Leo: Are we still meeting in Kyoto at seven? Please let me know before I leave the bakery.
questions: The client wants a new cover.
What is the file deadline in Apply?
When does Leo need an update?

choose: I will ask (before / between) I decide.
choices: The client wants a new cover.
What is the file deadline in Apply?
When does Leo need an update?

situation: You are Emma. Your tutor is Leo, calling about tonight's plan. Read the new update card. These times replace the earlier messages.
あなたはエマ役、講師は今夜の予定について電話してきたレオ役です。新しい連絡カードを読みましょう。このカードの時刻が前の連絡に代わる最新情報です。
task: Read the new update. Explain the deadline and possible finish. Tell Leo when you will message again.
新しい連絡を読み、締め切りと終了見込みを説明しましょう。次に連絡する時刻をレオに伝えましょう。
mission.title: Latest Update - Tonight's Plan
mission.text:
New update, 6:10 p.m.
The client wants one more change. File deadline: 8 p.m. Possible finish: about 8:30, not certain. Ren checks images. Emma finishes the cover.

Emma must cancel the seven p.m. Kyoto meeting. Send Leo another update by 7:30, even if work is not finished. Arrival time in Kyoto is unknown. Check travel after work.
lines: Are we still meeting at seven?
What changed? When are the files due?
Will you certainly finish at eight-thirty?
Should I wait at the station?
Please tell me when you know your travel plan.
mission.evidence: Latest deadline eight, estimated finish eight thirty, update by seven thirty even unfinished. Explain client change; cancel seven meeting, acknowledge inconvenience, do not invent train or arrival times. Agree a practical next step with Leo.

topics: Do you call or send messages?
When do you call a friend?
What do you say when you are busy?
What do you say when you are late?
Who needs to know about a change?
How do you choose a new time?
How do you ask someone to repeat?
How do you show you understand?
trivia: “By seven” means no later than seven. “At seven” gives an exact time. These small words can change a plan.
by seven は7時までに、at seven は7時に、という意味です。短い語でも予定の意味が変わります。
triviaQuestion: Does “by seven” mean no later than seven?
episode.closing: Emma sends Leo a clearer update. After the project is completed, Ren invites her to dinner to celebrate.
